SELECT COALESCE(SUM(profile.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(profile.deleted_at IS NULL AND () = 1), 0) AS active, COALESCE(SUM(profile.deleted_at IS NULL AND () = 2), 0) AS muted, COALESCE(SUM(profile.deleted_at IS NULL AND () = 3), 0) AS banned, COALESCE(SUM(profile.deleted_at IS NULL AND profile.role IN (2, 3)), 0) AS operators, COALESCE(SUM(profile.deleted_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS deactivated FROM user_profile profile
